title: Verify client lifecycle notifications over web realtime in UGO TEST

last_failure.cause: canonical authenticated browser stayed in-session, but .ugo-notification-live.is-client never rendered the expected UGO · ACTUALIZACIÓN DEL PEDIDO banner within 30s
last_failure.next_fix: inspect client realtime notification subscription/delivery and scheduler attempt accounting before retry
last_failure.review_resolution: Root cause confirmed: trg_notificar_estado_servicio is AFTER UPDATE of estado/proveedor_id. The readiness fixture inserted the row already in estado=asignado with proveedor_id set, so proveedor_asignado could never be emitted. Attempt 6 will create a neutral disposable row and perform a real UPDATE to asignado after the canonical client is authenticated and subscribed.
